-- =============================================================================
-- Primer_R6EnemyChassis
-- Rebuilds the R6 enemy rig primer from free Marketplace assets.
-- Pulls a humanoid R6 rig, configures it as a combat-ready enemy chassis,
-- and registers it in ServerStorage.MonsterTemplates for VictimService.
--
-- AERIAL_HAWK_PRESET note:
--   Set ARCHETYPE = "aerial" to apply wing physics offsets and disable
--   Humanoid.WalkSpeed (aerial enemies use BodyVelocity instead).
-- =============================================================================

local ENABLE_ON_BOOT = false   -- flip to true when you want it to run
if not ENABLE_ON_BOOT then return end

-- ── Config ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

local ARCHETYPES = {
	ground = {
		name               = "Primer_Ground_R6",
		maxHealth          = 200,
		walkSpeed          = 16,
		useBodyVelocity    = false,
		marketplaceAssetId = 0,   -- 0 = blocky fallback
	},
	aerial = {
		name               = "Primer_Aerial_R6",
		maxHealth          = 120,
		walkSpeed          = 0,   -- BodyVelocity drives movement, NOT WalkSpeed
		useBodyVelocity    = true,
		marketplaceAssetId = 0,   -- fill with real asset ID once sourced
		hoverHeight        = 18,
		diveSpeed          = 60,
	},
}

local ARCHETYPE = "aerial"   -- swap to "ground" for ground chassis

-- ── Services ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

local InsertService = game:GetService("InsertService")
local ServerStorage = game:GetService("ServerStorage")

-- ── Helpers ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

local function ensureFolder(parent, name)
	local f = parent:FindFirstChild(name)
	if f and f:IsA("Folder") then return f end
	f = Instance.new("Folder")
	f.Name = name
	f.Parent = parent
	return f
end

local function buildBlockyR6Fallback(cfg)
	local model = Instance.new("Model")
	model.Name  = cfg.name

	local function part(name, size, cframe, color)
		local p = Instance.new("Part")
		p.Name       = name
		p.Size       = size
		p.CFrame     = cframe
		p.BrickColor = BrickColor.new(color or "Medium stone grey")
		p.Anchored   = false
		p.CanCollide = true
		p.Parent     = model
		return p
	end

	local function weld(p0, p1)
		local w = Instance.new("WeldConstraint")
		w.Part0  = p0
		w.Part1  = p1
		w.Parent = p0
	end

	local root  = part("HumanoidRootPart", Vector3.new(2,2,1), CFrame.new(0,5,0), "Bright blue")
	local torso = part("Torso",            Vector3.new(2,2,1), CFrame.new(0,5,0))
	local head  = part("Head",             Vector3.new(2,1,1), CFrame.new(0,6.5,0))
	local lArm  = part("Left Arm",         Vector3.new(1,2,1), CFrame.new(-1.5,5,0))
	local rArm  = part("Right Arm",        Vector3.new(1,2,1), CFrame.new(1.5,5,0))
	local lLeg  = part("Left Leg",         Vector3.new(1,2,1), CFrame.new(-0.5,3,0))
	local rLeg  = part("Right Leg",        Vector3.new(1,2,1), CFrame.new(0.5,3,0))

	weld(root, torso); weld(torso, head)
	weld(torso, lArm); weld(torso, rArm)
	weld(torso, lLeg); weld(torso, rLeg)

	if cfg.useBodyVelocity then
		local lWing = part("Wing_L", Vector3.new(4,0.3,2), CFrame.new(-3,5,0), "Bright yellow")
		local rWing = part("Wing_R", Vector3.new(4,0.3,2), CFrame.new(3,5,0),  "Bright yellow")
		lWing.Transparency = 0.4
		rWing.Transparency = 0.4
		weld(torso, lWing)
		weld(torso, rWing)

		-- BodyVelocity: aerial drive (WalkSpeed is NOT used for aerial enemies)
		local bv = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
		bv.Name     = "AerialDrive"
		bv.Velocity = Vector3.new(0,0,0)
		bv.MaxForce = Vector3.new(1e4,1e4,1e4)
		bv.Parent   = root

		-- BodyGyro: holds orientation during flight
		local bg = Instance.new("BodyGyro")
		bg.Name      = "AerialGyro"
		bg.MaxTorque = Vector3.new(1e5,1e5,1e5)
		bg.D         = 100
		bg.Parent    = root
	end

	local hum = Instance.new("Humanoid")
	hum.RigType   = Enum.HumanoidRigType.R6
	hum.MaxHealth = cfg.maxHealth
	hum.Health    = cfg.maxHealth
	hum.WalkSpeed = cfg.walkSpeed
	hum.Parent    = model

	model.PrimaryPart = root
	return model
end

local function buildFromMarketplace(assetId, cfg)
	local ok, result = pcall(function()
		return InsertService:LoadAsset(assetId)
	end)
	if not ok then
		warn(string.format("[PRIMER] Marketplace load failed (assetId=%d): %s", assetId, tostring(result)))
		return nil
	end
	local rig = result:FindFirstChildOfClass("Model")
	if rig then rig.Parent = nil end
	result:Destroy()
	if not rig then
		warn("[PRIMER] No Model inside Marketplace asset — falling back")
		return nil
	end

	local hum = rig:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") or Instance.new("Humanoid", rig)
	hum.MaxHealth = cfg.maxHealth
	hum.Health    = cfg.maxHealth
	hum.WalkSpeed = cfg.walkSpeed
	hum.RigType   = Enum.HumanoidRigType.R6

	local hrp = rig:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if hrp then
		rig.PrimaryPart = hrp
		if cfg.useBodyVelocity then
			if not hrp:FindFirstChild("AerialDrive") then
				local bv = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
				bv.Name = "AerialDrive"
				bv.Velocity = Vector3.new(0,0,0)
				bv.MaxForce = Vector3.new(1e4,1e4,1e4)
				bv.Parent = hrp
			end
			if not hrp:FindFirstChild("AerialGyro") then
				local bg = Instance.new("BodyGyro")
				bg.Name = "AerialGyro"
				bg.MaxTorque = Vector3.new(1e5,1e5,1e5)
				bg.D = 100
				bg.Parent = hrp
			end
		end
	end

	rig.Name = cfg.name
	return rig
end

-- ── Main ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

task.wait(1)

local cfg = ARCHETYPES[ARCHETYPE]
assert(cfg, "[PRIMER] Unknown ARCHETYPE: " .. tostring(ARCHETYPE))

print(string.format("[PRIMER] Building %s chassis (assetId=%d)…", cfg.name, cfg.marketplaceAssetId))

local rig
if cfg.marketplaceAssetId and cfg.marketplaceAssetId > 0 then
	rig = buildFromMarketplace(cfg.marketplaceAssetId, cfg)
end
rig = rig or buildBlockyR6Fallback(cfg)

local templates = ensureFolder(ServerStorage, "MonsterTemplates")
local existing  = templates:FindFirstChild(cfg.name)
if existing then existing:Destroy() end
rig.Parent = templates

-- Stamp OMC attributes so VictimService/director can read archetype without parsing script
rig:SetAttribute("OMC_Archetype",          ARCHETYPE)
rig:SetAttribute("OMC_MaxHealth",          cfg.maxHealth)
rig:SetAttribute("OMC_UseBodyVelocity",    cfg.useBodyVelocity or false)
if cfg.useBodyVelocity then
	rig:SetAttribute("OMC_HoverHeight", cfg.hoverHeight or 18)
	rig:SetAttribute("OMC_DiveSpeed",   cfg.diveSpeed   or 60)
end
rig:SetAttribute("OMC_MarketplaceAssetId", cfg.marketplaceAssetId or 0)
rig:SetAttribute("OMC_PrimerVersion",      "1.0.0")

print(string.format("[PRIMER] ✓ %s ready in ServerStorage.MonsterTemplates", cfg.name))
print(string.format("[PRIMER]   Archetype=%s | Health=%d | BodyVelocity=%s | HoverHeight=%s",
	ARCHETYPE, cfg.maxHealth, tostring(cfg.useBodyVelocity),
	tostring(cfg.useBodyVelocity and cfg.hoverHeight or "n/a")))

local part = workspace:FindFirstChild("Bald Eagle")
if not part then print("NOT FOUND") return end

local mesh = part:FindFirstChildOfClass("SpecialMesh")
if mesh then
	print("MeshType:", mesh.MeshType)
	print("MeshId:", mesh.MeshId)
	print("TextureId:", mesh.TextureId)
	print("Scale:", mesh.Scale)
	print("Offset:", mesh.Offset)
else
	print("No SpecialMesh found")
end

print("Part.Size:", part.Size)
print("Part.Color:", part.Color)
print("Part.Material:", part.Material)
print("Part.CFrame:", part.CFrame)

-- =============================================================================
-- BuildAerialHawkChassis
-- Wraps the Bald Eagle mesh asset into a full combat-ready aerial enemy chassis.
-- HumanoidRootPart = physics root (BodyVelocity drives movement)
-- Eagle mesh welded to root as pure visual
-- Humanoid present for health/damage compatibility with VictimService
-- FSM: PATROL → CHASE → DIVE → RECOVER → STUNNED → DEAD
-- Co-op kill gate: requires 2 players within 20 studs
-- =============================================================================

local ENABLE_ON_BOOT = false
if not ENABLE_ON_BOOT then return end

-- ── Mesh Config (fill from __TMP_ReadEagle output) ────────────────────────────
local MESH_ID    = ""   -- e.g. "rbxassetid://123456789"
local TEXTURE_ID = ""   -- e.g. "rbxassetid://123456789"
local MESH_SCALE = Vector3.new(1, 1, 1)  -- adjust after visual check

-- ── Archetype Config ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
local CFG = {
	name         = "AerialHawk",
	maxHealth    = 120,
	hoverHeight  = 18,    -- studs above terrain
	patrolRadius = 60,    -- studs
	chaseRange   = 45,    -- studs — aggro range
	diveSpeed    = 60,    -- studs/s
	diveRange    = 12,    -- studs — switches to dive when player within this
	recoverTime  = 2.2,   -- seconds after dive before re-entering PATROL
	coopKillRadius = 20,  -- studs — both players must be within this to finish
	coopKillCount  = 2,   -- players required for co-op kill
}

-- ── Services ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
local ServerStorage = game:GetService("ServerStorage")
local RunService    = game:GetService("RunService")
local Players       = game:GetService("Players")

-- ── Build chassis ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
local function buildChassis()
	local model = Instance.new("Model")
	model.Name  = CFG.name

	-- Physics root
	local root = Instance.new("Part")
	root.Name        = "HumanoidRootPart"
	root.Size        = Vector3.new(2, 1, 3)
	root.Transparency = 1       -- invisible — mesh is the visual
	root.CanCollide  = false
	root.Anchored    = false
	root.Parent      = model

	-- Visual mesh part
	local body = Instance.new("Part")
	body.Name        = "Body"
	body.Size        = Vector3.new(2, 1, 3)
	body.Anchored    = false
	body.CanCollide  = false
	body.CastShadow  = true
	body.Parent      = model

	if MESH_ID ~= "" then
		local mesh = Instance.new("SpecialMesh")
		mesh.MeshType  = Enum.MeshType.FileMesh
		mesh.MeshId    = MESH_ID
		mesh.TextureId = TEXTURE_ID
		mesh.Scale     = MESH_SCALE
		mesh.Parent    = body
	else
		-- Blocky stand-in until mesh IDs are filled
		body.BrickColor = BrickColor.new("Bright yellow")
		body.Size       = Vector3.new(4, 0.5, 3)
		local lWing = Instance.new("Part")
		lWing.Name = "Wing_L"; lWing.Size = Vector3.new(4,0.3,2)
		lWing.BrickColor = BrickColor.new("Bright yellow")
		lWing.Anchored = false; lWing.CanCollide = false
		lWing.Parent = model
		local rWing = Instance.new("Part")
		rWing.Name = "Wing_R"; rWing.Size = Vector3.new(4,0.3,2)
		rWing.BrickColor = BrickColor.new("Bright yellow")
		rWing.Anchored = false; rWing.CanCollide = false
		rWing.Parent = model
		local function weld(p0,p1,cf)
			local w = Instance.new("WeldConstraint")
			w.Part0=p0; w.Part1=p1; w.Parent=p0
		end
		weld(root,body); weld(root,lWing); weld(root,rWing)
	end

	-- Weld body to root
	local bodyWeld = Instance.new("WeldConstraint")
	bodyWeld.Part0 = root; bodyWeld.Part1 = body; bodyWeld.Parent = root

	-- BodyVelocity — aerial drive (NOT Humanoid.WalkSpeed)
	local bv = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
	bv.Name     = "AerialDrive"
	bv.Velocity  = Vector3.new(0,0,0)
	bv.MaxForce  = Vector3.new(1e4,1e4,1e4)
	bv.Parent    = root

	-- BodyGyro — orientation hold
	local bg = Instance.new("BodyGyro")
	bg.Name      = "AerialGyro"
	bg.MaxTorque = Vector3.new(1e5,1e5,1e5)
	bg.D         = 100
	bg.Parent    = root

	-- Humanoid — health/damage, VictimService compatibility
	local hum = Instance.new("Humanoid")
	hum.RigType   = Enum.HumanoidRigType.R6
	hum.MaxHealth = CFG.maxHealth
	hum.Health    = CFG.maxHealth
	hum.WalkSpeed = 0    -- aerial: NEVER use WalkSpeed
	hum.Parent    = model

	-- Hitbox (visible collision volume for player attacks)
	local hitbox = Instance.new("Part")
	hitbox.Name        = "Hitbox"
	hitbox.Size        = Vector3.new(3, 1.5, 3)
	hitbox.Transparency = 0.8
	hitbox.CanCollide  = false
	hitbox.BrickColor  = BrickColor.new("Bright red")
	hitbox.Parent      = model
	local hw = Instance.new("WeldConstraint")
	hw.Part0=root; hw.Part1=hitbox; hw.Parent=root

	model.PrimaryPart = root

	-- OMC attributes for director contract
	model:SetAttribute("OMC_Archetype",       "aerial")
	model:SetAttribute("OMC_MaxHealth",       CFG.maxHealth)
	model:SetAttribute("OMC_HoverHeight",     CFG.hoverHeight)
	model:SetAttribute("OMC_DiveSpeed",       CFG.diveSpeed)
	model:SetAttribute("OMC_CoopKillRadius",  CFG.coopKillRadius)
	model:SetAttribute("OMC_CoopKillCount",   CFG.coopKillCount)
	model:SetAttribute("OMC_PrimerVersion",   "1.0.0")
	model:SetAttribute("OMC_MeshGrounded",    MESH_ID ~= "")

	return model
end

-- ── FSM ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
local FSM_STATES = { "PATROL", "CHASE", "DIVE", "RECOVER", "STUNNED", "DEAD" }

local function getNearestPlayer(rootPos)
	local nearest, dist = nil, math.huge
	for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		local char = p.Character
		local hrp  = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if hrp then
			local d = (hrp.Position - rootPos).Magnitude
			if d < dist then nearest = p; dist = d end
		end
	end
	return nearest, dist
end

local function getPlayersWithinRadius(rootPos, radius)
	local found = {}
	for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		local char = p.Character
		local hrp  = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if hrp and (hrp.Position - rootPos).Magnitude <= radius then
			table.insert(found, p)
		end
	end
	return found
end

local function runFSM(model)
	local root  = model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local hum   = model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	local bv    = root and root:FindFirstChild("AerialDrive")
	local bg    = root and root:FindFirstChild("AerialGyro")
	if not (root and hum and bv and bg) then
		warn("[HAWK FSM] Missing required parts — aborting")
		return
	end

	local state       = "PATROL"
	local patrolAngle = 0
	local patrolOrigin = root.Position
	local recoverTimer = 0

	model:SetAttribute("OMC_FSMState", state)

	RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
		if not model.Parent then return end
		if hum.Health <= 0 then
			state = "DEAD"
			bv.Velocity = Vector3.new(0,0,0)
			model:SetAttribute("OMC_FSMState", "DEAD")
			return
		end

		local rootPos = root.Position
		local nearest, dist = getNearestPlayer(rootPos)

		-- Height correction — keep above terrain
		local targetY   = patrolOrigin.Y + CFG.hoverHeight
		local currentY  = rootPos.Y
		local yCorrect  = (targetY - currentY) * 3

		if state == "PATROL" then
			patrolAngle += dt * 0.4
			local px = patrolOrigin.X + math.cos(patrolAngle) * CFG.patrolRadius
			local pz = patrolOrigin.Z + math.sin(patrolAngle) * CFG.patrolRadius
			local dir = Vector3.new(px - rootPos.X, yCorrect, pz - rootPos.Z)
			bv.Velocity = dir.Unit * 18
			if bg then bg.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(rootPos, rootPos + dir) end

			if nearest and dist < CFG.chaseRange then
				state = "CHASE"
				model:SetAttribute("OMC_FSMState", "CHASE")
			end

		elseif state == "CHASE" then
			if not nearest or dist > CFG.chaseRange * 1.3 then
				state = "PATROL"
				model:SetAttribute("OMC_FSMState", "PATROL")
				return
			end
			local char = nearest.Character
			local tHRP = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			if not tHRP then return end
			local toTarget = tHRP.Position - rootPos
			bv.Velocity = toTarget.Unit * 28
			if bg then bg.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(rootPos, rootPos + toTarget) end

			-- Height gate: switch to dive only when high enough above target
			local heightAboveTarget = rootPos.Y - tHRP.Position.Y
			if dist < CFG.diveRange and heightAboveTarget > 8 then
				state = "DIVE"
				model:SetAttribute("OMC_FSMState", "DIVE")
			end

		elseif state == "DIVE" then
			if not nearest then state = "RECOVER"; return end
			local char = nearest.Character
			local tHRP = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			if not tHRP then state = "RECOVER"; return end
			local toTarget = tHRP.Position - rootPos
			bv.Velocity = toTarget.Unit * CFG.diveSpeed
			if bg then bg.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(rootPos, rootPos + toTarget) end

			-- Hit check
			if dist < 4 then
				local tHum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
				if tHum then tHum:TakeDamage(30) end
				state = "RECOVER"
				recoverTimer = CFG.recoverTime
				model:SetAttribute("OMC_FSMState", "RECOVER")
			end

		elseif state == "RECOVER" then
			recoverTimer -= dt
			-- Climb back to hover height
			bv.Velocity = Vector3.new(0, 20, 0)
			if recoverTimer <= 0 then
				state = "PATROL"
				model:SetAttribute("OMC_FSMState", "PATROL")
			end

		elseif state == "STUNNED" then
			bv.Velocity = Vector3.new(0,0,0)
			-- External systems set/clear STUNNED via attribute
			if model:GetAttribute("OMC_Stunned") ~= true then
				state = "PATROL"
				model:SetAttribute("OMC_FSMState", "PATROL")
			end
		end

		-- Co-op kill gate: only allow finishing blow if 2+ players nearby
		local nearby = getPlayersWithinRadius(rootPos, CFG.coopKillRadius)
		model:SetAttribute("OMC_CoopKillReady", #nearby >= CFG.coopKillCount)
	end)
end

-- ── Spawn ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
task.wait(1)

local hawk = buildChassis()
hawk.Parent = workspace

-- Position above terrain center
local root = hawk:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
if root then
	root.CFrame = CFrame.new(0, CFG.hoverHeight, 0)
end

-- Also register in MonsterTemplates
local templates = ServerStorage:FindFirstChild("MonsterTemplates")
	or Instance.new("Folder", ServerStorage)
templates.Name = "MonsterTemplates"
local clone = hawk:Clone()
clone.Name = "AerialHawk_Template"
clone.Parent = templates

runFSM(hawk)

print("[HAWK] AerialHawk spawned — FSM running. State: PATROL")
print("[HAWK] MeshGrounded:", hawk:GetAttribute("OMC_MeshGrounded"))
print("[HAWK] CoopKillCount:", CFG.coopKillCount, "| CoopKillRadius:", CFG.coopKillRadius)

local MESH_ID    = "http://www.roblox.com/asset/?id=120647529"
local TEXTURE_ID = "http://www.roblox.com/asset/?id=120647378"
local MESH_SCALE = Vector3.new(1.25, 1.25, 1.25)
